steps.message: ENKI covers (0, 1) -> (1, 1) -> (1, 0) -> (0, 0) because (0, 0) lies on only one word that still fits
PILLOW covers (0, 3) -> (1, 3) -> (1, 2) -> (2, 2) -> (2, 3) -> (3, 3) because (0, 3) has one open neighbour, so a word ends there, and only this fits
PATKA covers (3, 2) -> (3, 1) -> (3, 0) -> (2, 0) -> (2, 1) because (2, 0) lies on only one word that still fits
